title: Regularization of the metric generalized inverse in Banach spaces and the dichotomy phenomenon
summary: For a bounded linear operator acting between Banach spaces, its metric generalized inverse is the analog to the prominent Moore-Penrose inverse for operators acting between Hilbert spaces. This generalized inverse is well-defined for Banach spaces that are strictly convex and reflexive. Previous studies had been restricted to closed range situations, where the metric generalized inverse constitutes a continuous homogeneous mapping. The focus of the present study is on the ill-posed situation in the sense of Nashed, when the governing operator has a non-closed range. We define and analyze…
